caption: Stop and give way
colour: white STOP on red octagon
explanation: You must stop completely at the line and only move off when it is safe; the road ahead has restricted visibility.
mnemonic: Only octagon on UK roads means STOP every time.
notes: Commons description: 'UK traffic sign: Stop (TSRGDNO 601.1)'. Only octagonal sign in TSRGD.

caption: Give way to traffic on major road
colour: red-bordered inverted triangle, white centre
explanation: Give way to traffic on the major road and only emerge when there is a safe gap; you need not stop if the way is clear.
mnemonic: Upside-down triangle = give way.
notes: Commons description: 'UK traffic sign: Give way (TSRGDNO 602)'. Inverted triangle is unique to give way.

caption: Maximum speed limit
colour: red circle, black number on white
explanation: Do not exceed the speed shown (here 30 mph); the limit applies until a different limit or the national speed limit sign is seen.
mnemonic: Red ring round a number = your ceiling speed.
notes: Diagram 670 is the maximum speed roundel; verified file 670V30 (30 mph) used as the canonical example. Commons: 'Maximum speed limit of 30 miles per hour (TSRGDNO 670V30)'.

caption: National speed limit applies
colour: white circle, black diagonal stripe
explanation: The national speed limit now applies for your vehicle and road type; know your limit, as a motorcycle is 60 mph on a single carriageway and 70 mph on a dual carriageway.
mnemonic: Black slash on white = national limit, you decide the number.
notes: Commons description: 'National speed limits apply (TSRGDNO 671)'.

caption: No entry for vehicular traffic
colour: white horizontal bar on red circle
explanation: Vehicles must not pass beyond this sign; it usually marks the exit of a one-way street, so do not enter.
mnemonic: Red circle, white bar = barred from entry.
notes: Commons description: 'No entry (TSRGDNO 616)'.

caption: No motor vehicles
colour: red circle, black car and motorcycle
explanation: Motor vehicles, including motorcycles, are prohibited beyond this point; do not ride through.
mnemonic: Car and bike crossed out = no engines allowed.
notes: Commons description: 'Motor vehicles prohibited (TSRGDNO 619)'. Shows car plus motorcycle symbol.

caption: No overtaking
colour: red circle, red car beside black car
explanation: Overtaking is prohibited until you pass an end sign; stay in lane and do not pull out to pass.
mnemonic: Red car can't pass black car.
notes: Commons description: 'No overtaking.' Two cars, one red, side by side in red circle.

caption: No U-turn
colour: red circle, black U-turn arrow
explanation: You must not make a U-turn here; continue and turn round elsewhere where it is permitted and safe.
mnemonic: U-arrow with a red ring = no turning back.
notes: Commons description: 'No U-turns.'

caption: No right turn
colour: red circle, black right arrow crossed out
explanation: Turning right is prohibited at this junction; carry on or find an alternative route.
mnemonic: Right arrow struck through = no right.
notes: Commons description: 'No right turn.'

caption: No left turn
colour: red circle, black left arrow crossed out
explanation: Turning left is prohibited at this junction; carry on or find an alternative route.
mnemonic: Left arrow struck through = no left.
notes: Commons description: 'No left turn.'

caption: Entry to 20 mph zone
colour: white sign, 20 roundel and 'ZONE'
explanation: You are entering a 20 mph zone with traffic-calming measures; keep to 20 mph until you see the end-of-zone sign.
mnemonic: ZONE word means it lasts, not just one limit.
notes: Commons description: 'Entrance to a 20 miles per hour speed limit zone (TSRGDNO 674)'.

caption: No stopping (clearway)
colour: blue circle, red border and red cross
explanation: You must not stop on the main carriageway at any time, even to set down or pick up; this is a clearway.
mnemonic: Red X means no stopping at all.
notes: Commons description: 'No stopping.' Blue circle with red ring and red diagonal cross (clearway).

caption: No waiting
colour: blue circle, red border and single red diagonal
explanation: You must not wait or park here, though you may stop briefly to load, unload, or set down passengers.
mnemonic: One red stroke = no waiting; two strokes (cross) = no stopping.
notes: Commons description: 'No waiting.' Blue circle with red ring and one red diagonal bar; distinct from clearway (which has a full cross).

caption: End of 20 mph zone
colour: white sign, grey 20 roundel and 30 limit
explanation: The 20 mph zone has ended and a new limit (commonly 30 mph) now applies; adjust your speed to the limit shown.
mnemonic: Greyed-out 20 = zone is over.
notes: Commons description: 'End of 20 miles per hour zone and start of 30 miles per hour zone (TSRGDNO 675)'.

caption: Maximum height
colour: red circle, height figure in black
explanation: Vehicles taller than the height shown must not proceed; if your machine plus load exceeds it, find another route.
mnemonic: Number with arrows top and bottom = how tall you can be.
notes: Commons description: 'Vehicles exceeding 14-6 in height prohibited (TSRGDNO 629.2)'. Imperial-only variant; modern dual-unit form is 629.2A.

caption: Maximum width
colour: red circle, width figure with side arrows
explanation: Vehicles wider than the width shown must not proceed; check your width including mirrors and load before continuing.
mnemonic: Arrows pointing in from each side = how wide you can be.
notes: Commons description: 'Vehicles exceeding 6-6 in width indicated prohibited (TSRGDNO 629)'. Width arrows point inward from the sides.

caption: Maximum gross weight
colour: red circle, weight in tonnes (black on white)
explanation: No vehicle over the gross weight shown (in tonnes) may pass, typically protecting a weak bridge or structure; do not proceed if you are over the limit.
mnemonic: Just a weight, no lorry = applies to every vehicle.
notes: Commons description: 'Vehicles exceeding a gross weight of 20T prohibited (TSRGDNO 626.1)'. Plain weight roundel (no lorry symbol) applying to all vehicles; this is the historic-style SVG available, matching the Highway Code 'no vehicles over maximum gross weight shown' design.

caption: Give priority to oncoming vehicles
colour: white circle, red border, red and black arrows
explanation: Priority must be given to oncoming vehicles at a narrow section; wait and let approaching traffic through before you proceed.
mnemonic: Big red arrow points at you, so you give way.
notes: Commons description: 'Priority must be given to vehicles from the opposite direction (TSRGDNO 615)'. Red arrow (you) yields to black arrow (oncoming). Pairs with mandatory blue 'priority over oncoming' 811.

caption: No cycling
colour: red circle, black bicycle
explanation: Riding pedal cycles is prohibited beyond this sign; cyclists must dismount or use another route.
mnemonic: Bicycle in a red ring = no riding here.
notes: Commons description: 'Riding of pedal cycles prohibited (TSRGDNO 951)'.

caption: No towed caravans
colour: red circle, black caravan
explanation: Towed caravans are prohibited beyond this point; if you are towing one, take an alternative route.
mnemonic: Caravan in a red ring = leave the van behind.
notes: Commons description: 'Towed caravans prohibited (TSRGDNO 622.7)'.

caption: Maximum length
colour: red circle, length figure with arrows
explanation: Vehicles longer than the length shown must not proceed; measure your machine plus any trailer before continuing.
mnemonic: Arrows front and back = how long you can be.
notes: Commons description: 'Vehicles exceeding 32 feet and 6 inches in length prohibited (TSRGDNO 629.1)'. Length arrows point outward front and rear.

caption: Parking restricted to permit holders
colour: white sign, blue 'permit holders only' panel
explanation: Parking here is reserved for permit holders only; do not park unless you hold a valid permit for the zone.
mnemonic: Permit holders only means no permit, no parking.
notes: Commons description: 'Parking only allowed for parking permit holders.' Diagram 660 permit-holders parking sign.

caption: No pedestrians
colour: red circle, black walking figure
explanation: Pedestrians are prohibited beyond this sign, for example on a slip road or in a tunnel; walking here is not allowed.
mnemonic: Walker in a red ring = no walking.
notes: Commons description: 'Pedestrians prohibited.' (TSRGDNO 625.1).

caption: No goods vehicles over weight shown
colour: red circle, black lorry with weight figure
explanation: Goods vehicles over the maximum gross weight shown are prohibited, except for access or loading; lighter vehicles and cars may still pass.
mnemonic: Lorry plus weight = only heavy goods vehicles are banned.
notes: Commons description: 'Vehicles exceeding a gross weight of 7.5t prohibited...' Lorry symbol plus weight; commonly 7.5t. Differs from plain weight sign (626.x) by the lorry symbol.

caption: No vehicles
colour: red circle, plain white centre
explanation: No vehicles of any kind may pass, except those being pushed by hand by a pedestrian; do not ride or drive through.
mnemonic: Empty red ring = no vehicles at all.
notes: Commons description: 'All vehicles prohibited except non-mechanically propelled vehicles being pushed by pedestrians' (TSRGDNO 617). Highway Code caption is 'No vehicles'.
